meteringCharges.description: Charges may vary, for more information, please visit the retailer's website flowpower.com.au/residential

electricityContract.terms: See Flow Power Market Retail Contract Agreement Terms at flowpower.com.au/residential/policies/

discounts.description: Applies to new customers only. To receive the full $150 credit (incl. GST), you must stay with Flow Power for 6 months, with a $25 credit applied across each of the first 6 electricity bills.

electricityContract.variation: Usage rates aren’t fixed. Your rate = 33.75 c/kWh base rate plus a monthly Price Efficiency Adjustment based on when you use power vs 5-min wholesale prices. Shift usage to cheaper times. flowpower.com.au/residential/pricing/our-pricing

eligibility.description: Customer must have existing solar panels
Customer must have an existing smart meter

Customer must have an EV. Usage price estimate based on a typical household solar system of 5kW, battery system of 12.5kWh and an EV with an average driving distance of 13,800km per vehicle per year, with a conversion of 20kWh per 100km

greenPowerCharges.description: This offer has 100% green power included in the offer rates.

solarFeedInTariff.description: Flow Power offers 2 cents per kWh exported. This rate is uncapped.

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailer's website at flowpower.com.au/residential/policies/
